description: Rimlight's real-music test corpus (feedback round 2): Creative Commons tracks for offline analysis only. fetch.py downloads and decodes them outside the repository; never commit the audio or anything that could reconstruct it.

tracks.title: Sugihara
tracks.format: 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV (channels averaged, soxr resampling), from the MP3 the source serves
tracks.notes: Live solo session: male voice and strummed acoustic guitar, no drums (low band: no kick striations in the screening sheet).
